passages.provision_quote: (2) The large load customer commits to significant and meaningful financial assurances that must: (A) include reimbursement by the large load customer of at least eighty percent (80%) of the project costs reasonably allocable to the large load customer;
passages.note: The enrolled act prints the operative text (a nuclear-manufacturing tax credit and expedited IURC review for generation plans and large load customer projects) but names no author and never names a data center.

rows.reasoning: Soliday authored HB 1007 (2025), which creates a small modular nuclear reactor manufacturing tax credit and expedited utility-commission review of generation plans and of projects serving a large load customer, defined by megawatts, capital investment and employment; the act never names a data center. Under the annex ruling of 2026-10-01, a provision about large-load utility customers that never names data centers is not about data centers, so it cannot reach any rung, including the cost-reimbursement language that might otherwise read toward the energy cost-sharing clause of allowing development with impact assessments, energy cost-sharing agreements, and community benefit requirements before approval.
